title: She Was Erased From Every Record | ECHO//30 Ep. 2
description:
By morning, every public record says Tara never existed—but her family still remembers her. When she refuses to stay silent, every screen inside the Neon Arcade answers.

Kavi's warning gets worse, Byte acts without permission, and sunset brings a threat Tara cannot fight with technology.
